readings: Among films whose replacement cost is at least 20.99, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded).
queries:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM per_rating
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_ratio,
       p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_mean
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean;
